choices.content: The perpendicular segment is the shortest
Supplementary angles of the same angle are equal
The line segment between two points is the shortest path

question.prompt: Straightening a winding road shortens the travel distance. The mathematical basis for this is

solutions.explanation: After the winding road is straightened, the route between the starting point and the endpoint becomes a line segment. Since “the line segment between two points is the shortest path,” the travel distance is shortened.
solutions.title: Shortest path between endpoints
